top_signals.title: Record Tanker Rates Leave Heavy Crude Stranded in the Americas
top_signals.summary: The Middle East crisis has driven tanker rates to all-time highs and created a shortage of vessels. This oil logistics problem is now causing a ripple effect, tipping the heavy crude market in North and South America into oversupply—while Asia and Europe grapple with a shortage of heavy grades. Canada is producing over 5 million barrels of crude daily, most of it heavy crude. Some 4 million barrels daily of that goes south to U.S. refineries. Venezuelan production has also moved higher after the U.S. disposed of the country’s government…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: KKR Sees Bond Rout as Opening to Lock in High-Grade Asian Credit
top_signals.summary: The global bond rout is giving fixed-income investors a rare chance to lock in Asian junk bond-like payouts without the credit risk of such debt, according to KKR & Co.
